reason: Across the CX-05 card the agent had to check which roles each RPC admits, decline the card's blanket gate, remove a misleading "owner" message, and write refusal tests per role. No existing index entry covers Eventar server-action role gating, so this is a new project-level class.
CX-05: the lock prop was wired on the details page first; the edit page also renders the wizard and was missed until a usage grep. A multi-page component needs the same gate on every page.

Backtest found the CX-05 accreditation wizard gated on role only while the RPC also requires the event creator. The UI offered controls the database always refused. The gate skill needs the ownership predicate, not just the role.

The updateEvent draft-only rule came from Ivan's ruling. Its ordering (org check before status) and the all-roles scope are reusable rules for future Eventar action gates, and the spec-amend step prevents the plan contradicting the code.
